summary.text: Hank Sanders is the Democratic and Independent Party of Oregon candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 52, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent against Republican Scott Hege.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in rural Oregon and worked as a journalist.

paragraphs.text: Sanders earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago in 2023, and Ballotpedia lists journalism as his profession.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked as a reporter for The New York Times and the Chicago Tribune and later worked for Congresswoman Dexter and in the Oregon State Senate.
He won the May 19 Democratic primary with 45.1 percent of the vote in a four-candidate field.
He said his priorities include a Home Hardening Strike Team to help lower home insurance costs, tax credits for rural childcare workers, and an agency to help people with Medicaid paperwork.
